page.layout: One page of running text, no margin notes. Running head at top centre. Text in one column with a centred heading "Explicatio;" and two sections, each with a canon and an explanation. Page number at top left. Catchword at bottom right. The right edge of the scan shows part of the facing page; it is not transcribed.

main_text.head: Explicatio;
main_text.p: Per Andalufiam Arabes intelligunt Hispaniam, Ommiadæ fuerunt posteri Ommiæ, quæ erat factio religiosa & politica inter Arabes. Se-deshujus Chalifatus fuit Corduba.
main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: Circa A.C. 1030, extincta penitus familia Ommiadum singularum urbium Præfecti per Hispaniam se Reges constituerunt, ita, ut XIX regna Saracenica in Hispania numerarentur, quorum hæc sunt nomina: Saragossa, Balaqueris, Montionis, Barbastri, Fraga, Albarracini, Dia-nii, Tudela, Majorica, Osca, Toleti, Murcia, Almeria, Pacis Augustæ, Portugallia, Sevilia, Corduba, Granada & Ilenda. Ex his solum Granadæ regnum Mauris remansit;

page.notes: The line "Se-deshujus" is printed with the word run together after the hyphen; transcribed as printed. "Dia-nii" is a word broken at the line end with a printed hyphen. The year "1030" is printed in old style figures and may be read with some doubt. The catchword "quod" stands below the last line. The right edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
